name: Amazon CloudWatch
tagline_ar: منصّة المراقبة: Metrics وLogs وAlarms وEvents وDashboards وSynthetics لرؤية شاملة لصحة وأداء الأنظمة.
tagline_en: Observability platform: Metrics, Logs, Alarms, Events, Dashboards, Synthetics for end-to-end system health and performance.

key_concepts.desc_ar: سلاسل زمنية موزّعة على namespaces/dimensions؛ standard كل دقيقة، detailed/custom بدقة أعلى.
key_concepts.desc_en: Time series grouped by namespace/dimensions; standard per minute, detailed/custom higher resolution.

key_concepts.desc_ar: CloudWatch Logs: Log Groups → Log Streams؛ retention قابل للضبط 1 يوم – Never Expire.
key_concepts.desc_en: CloudWatch Logs: Log Groups → Log Streams; retention 1 day – Never Expire.

key_concepts.desc_ar: استعلام SQL-like على log groups (5 خلف المجموعات كحد).
key_concepts.desc_en: SQL-like query over log groups (up to 50 groups per query).

key_concepts.desc_ar: يستخرج أرقام من Logs ويحوّلها إلى CloudWatch metric.
key_concepts.desc_en: Extracts values from Logs into a CloudWatch metric.

key_concepts.desc_ar: حالات OK/INSUFFICIENT_DATA/ALARM على metric؛ تشغّل SNS, Auto Scaling, EC2 action.
key_concepts.desc_en: OK/INSUFFICIENT_DATA/ALARM states on a metric; trigger SNS, Auto Scaling, or EC2 actions.

key_concepts.desc_ar: يجمع عدة alarms بتعابير AND/OR لتقليل noise.
key_concepts.desc_en: Combines multiple alarms via AND/OR rule expressions to reduce noise.

key_concepts.desc_ar: يجمع system metrics ولوجات من EC2/On-Prem عبر ملف JSON config.
key_concepts.desc_en: Collects system metrics and logs from EC2/On-Prem via JSON config.

cli_commands.cmd: aws cloudwatch put-metric-data --namespace MyApp --metric-name Orders --value 1 --unit Count

aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --alarm-name high-cpu --metric-name CPUUtilization --namespace AWS/EC2 --threshold 80 --comparison-operator GreaterThanThreshold --evaluation-periods 2 --period 60 --statistic Average --alarm-actions arn:aws:sns:...

when_to_use.scenario_ar: مراقبة صحة موارد AWS برسوم بيانية وalarms
when_to_use.scenario_en: Monitor AWS resources with graphs and alarms

when_to_use.scenario_ar: إشعار عند أخطاء محددة في اللوجات

exam_tips.ar: 1-minute metrics تُحفظ 15 يوم، 5-minute 63 يوم، 1-hour 455 يوم (15 شهر).
exam_tips.en: 1-min metrics retained 15 days, 5-min 63 days, 1-hour 455 days (15 months).

exam_tips.ar: High-resolution (1s) alarms ممكنة فقط مع custom metrics StorageResolution=1 ويدعمها period=10s أو 30s.
exam_tips.en: High-res (1s) alarms only with custom metrics StorageResolution=1 and period 10s or 30s.

exam_tips.ar: EC2 Standard Monitoring = كل 5 دقائق؛ Detailed Monitoring = كل دقيقة (مدفوع).
exam_tips.en: EC2 Standard Monitoring = every 5 min; Detailed Monitoring = every 1 min (paid).

exam_tips.ar: Metric Filter يحوّل لوجات إلى metric — لا يغيّر محتوى اللوج ولا يعيد معالجة قديمة.
exam_tips.en: Metric Filter turns logs into a metric — doesn't modify logs or process history.

exam_tips.ar: Alarm يدخل INSUFFICIENT_DATA عندما لا توجد datapoints — يمكن اعتبارها OK أو ALARM.
exam_tips.en: Alarm enters INSUFFICIENT_DATA on missing data — treat as OK or ALARM via TreatMissingData.
